content:
Honestly, this scene was basically tailor-made for anyone who deals with the devil.

During Wednesday's episode of 'The Daily Show,' host Josh Johnson pointed out a detail from Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding that looks like it walked straight out of a wildly popular horror film — and once you see it, you can't unsee it.

Johnson played a clip of Trump sharing footage from his wedding to socialite Bettina Trump on social media. The wedding was held in May on a small island in the Bahamas, before delivering his punchline.

The clip features an acoustic version of The Ronettes' 'Be My Baby' as background music. It opens with an aerial shot of the church where the president's eldest son got married, then shows the interior with the guests. The video shows Trump Jr.'s siblings Ivanka and Tiffany Trump sitting in the pews, before cutting to slow-motion footage of the bride and groom embracing at the altar beneath a massive crucifix.

Johnson quipped: 'What a beautiful wedding ceremony — in the church from "Sinners."' A still from the Oscar-winning film was shown beside him as he spoke, depicting Sammie (played by Miles Caton) walking into his father's blood-soaked church. Above Sammie — just like Don Jr. and his bride — hangs a massive crucifix. The exterior of the church in 'Sinners' also bears a striking resemblance to the one in the Bahamas.

Donald Trump Jr.'s wedding came under scrutiny earlier after ProPublica reported that it had been funded by Russian oligarch Umar Kremlev, who has close ties to President Vladimir Putin.

In response to the furore, Bettina Trump issued a statement on Instagram clarifying: 'Don and I got married privately on Friday with only our family present.'

She continued: 'The weekend that followed had been planned well in advance as a weekend to gather with friends. It was never arranged as our wedding weekend. Our original wedding plans changed, and we simply decided to get married earlier, and then attend the already-planned weekend event as a newlywed couple.'

She went on to write that the couple's 'dear friend Umar generously hosted two wonderful, unforgettable celebratory evenings for us following the wedding.'

Johnson had a pretty funny response to Bettina Trump's clarification as well.

Johnson, mimicking Bettina Trump's tone, said: 'Yes, that's right, fake news. They didn't plan my wedding — they planned my more expensive after-party.'
